error.missing_grid_signal: Either net_grid_sensor OR (grid_import_sensor + grid_export_sensor) is required.
error.mutual_exclusivity_failed: grid_import and grid_export are both > 0; one of them is likely wired backwards.
error.negative_solar: Solar production sensor reports a persistent negative value; check clamp direction.
error.ev_draw_implausible: EV consumption doesn't match the expected draw for the set charge current.

init.title: Grid limit
init.description: Optional. Pause or reduce charging when the house is close to its contracted power. Leave everything empty to turn this off.

data.grid_usage_sensor: Grid usage power sensor (import, including the EV)

data_description.grid_near_limit_sensor: Charging stops while this is on, in every mode including force-max.
data_description.grid_usage_sensor: With a contracted power set, charging is reduced so usage stays under the limit minus the margin, and stops if less than the minimum current fits.
data_description.grid_resume_delay_seconds: How long the limit must stay clear before charging resumes or the cap is raised.
